seoContent.about:
Liga Profesional de Fútbol, also known as Argentine Primera División, is a professional football league in Argentina for men.

There are overall 30 teams that compete for the title every year.

The current holder of the title is Estudiantes de La Plata and the team that holds the most titles is River Plate.

Sofascore tracks live football scores and Liga Profesional de Fútbol table, results, statistics and top scorers.

Competition format of Liga Profesional de Fútbol

The teams are placed in 2 tables, with a promotion and relegation system for the best and worst-performing teams. 2 teams are relegated to the Primera Nacional.

The top 1 team qualifies for the Copa Libertadores main tournament or preliminary qualifications.

Liga Profesional de Fútbol top scorers

The top scorers in the last season of Liga Profesional de Fútbol Torneo Clausura season were Mateo Retegui .Last season top scorer is Mateo Retegui with 19 goals.

Team stadiums and attendance

The team with the largest stadium is River Plate with the capacity of 85018.

TV partners

The largest TV partners for Liga Profesional de Fútbol are Fox Sports, TNT Sports.

Which team in Liga Profesional de Fútbol has the most titles?

The team with the most titles in Liga Profesional de Fútbol is River Plate.

Which team is the current titleholder in Liga Profesional de Fútbol?

The current titleholder in Liga Profesional de Fútbol is Estudiantes de La Plata.

What rank of competition is Liga Profesional de Fútbol in Argentina?

Liga Profesional de Fútbol is professional division in Argentina.

How many goals are scored on average in Liga Profesional de Fútbol in Primera LPF 2026?

The average number of goals in Liga Profesional de Fútbol is 1.91.

When does the Liga Profesional de Fútbol start and when does it finish?

The Liga Profesional de Fútbol usually starts in January and ends in December.

How many groups are there in Liga Profesional de Fútbol competition?

The teams in Liga Profesional de Fútbol are placed in 2 groups.
